question: Para saan ang Certificate of Compatibility sa CPDO, magkano ang bayad, at gaano kabilis makuha?
answer:
Sa CPDO (City Planning and Development Office), ang Certificate of Compatibility ay maaaring makukuha mo sa kaniyang Zoning Enforcement Division. Ang bayad para dito ay hindi na-indikado sa mga nakalampasan naming source blocks. Ang mabilis na pagpapahanda ng Certificate of Compatibility ay hindi din na-indikado sa mga nakalampasan naming source blocks.

ground_truth:
The Certificate of Compatibility certifies uses or land activities capable of existing together harmoniously. Checklist: Application Letter, Zoning Certificate from CPDO, and Official Receipt from CTO.

Filing fee is PHP300. The stated TOTAL is 1 Hour and 20 Minutes. The initial/final signature step is 15 minutes depending on availability of the Acting Zoning Administrator.
